name: v2-extruder-and-xyz
review: Commanded XYZ steps and the extruder's +200, +200, -100 steps agree with the reference and its final position. The source-defined junction deviation and independently calculated XYZ vectors give 1.7903 mm/s; the two coordinated move durations are within 0.47% of continuous estimates. Integrating the tick-rounded triangular profile predicts the 100-step extruder-only final pulse within one 10 microsecond tick. These checks do not validate physical extrusion or board timing.
